title: Write the pushing rule
description: A crate can move only if the tile behind it is free. Write the condition that allows a push.
hint: Explain dx and dy and how board.is_free(crate.x + dx, crate.y + dy) checks the tile beyond the crate. Let me write the returned condition.
starter: # A crate puzzle: your code defines its controls and rules.

guide.instruction: Return whether the tile beyond the crate is free. Use crate.x + dx and crate.y + dy.
guide.review: Try pushing into a free tile and toward a wall. Only the free tile should work.
